endorsements.quote: To counteract these biases, it is essential to increase the diversity of AI training datasets and maintain robust evaluation protocols that ensure accuracy and interrater reliability across patient populations.

unlisted_practices: Expand implementation of AI-driven digital wound care technology to address inequities in access to timely, high-quality care for older adults in rural and remote communities.
Provide continuous training and onboarding opportunities for staff using AI tools to address staff turnover.

screen.reason: This is a viewpoint paper that reflects on initial implementations of digital wound care technology (AI-driven) and encourages clinicians and health leaders to adopt and expand such systems to address access and equity issues.
